The Role

This is a UK-based role that makes the AI systems which power our products measurably better. How well those systems perform is at the heart of what Aykua offers. You will design the evaluations that tell us how accurate they are, find out why they fail, and run the experiments that fix it. You will statistically assess prompt and model performance and maintain our internal evaluation frameworks. The role suits a scientist with rigorous experimental habits, from a PhD, postdoc or equivalent industry experience, who wants their work to ship in a product which real clinics are using today.

What You’ll Do

Improve how we measure AI quality: extend the evaluation frameworks for our existing products and stand up new ones as products are built, assessing prompt and model performance statistically and designing experiments that compare changes rigorously.

Build and continuously improve our LLM-as-judge evaluations: calibrate judges against expert human review, find where they fail, and feed what you learn back into our prompts, models and products.

Curate and maintain our internal evaluation datasets, working with expert reviewers to establish and keep ground truth.

Work closely with our product and engineering teams to turn your findings into improvements that reach production.

Mentor the team in evaluation and experimental practice, establish best practices, and raise the technical bar for how we measure AI quality across the company.

What We’re Looking For

A PhD and postdoctoral research experience, or equivalent industry experience (5+ years), in data science, machine learning or a related quantitative field.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python (with libraries like Pydantic, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).

A strong foundation in statistical analysis, experimental design and hypothesis testing, and experience applying it to large or messy datasets.

Experience turning analysis into working tools: evaluation harnesses, data pipelines or reusable experiment code that others on the team can run.

You will be a great fit if you...

Enjoy working with frontier models.

Would rather measure whether something works than assume it does.

Automate away repetitive analysis and build tooling that makes evaluation faster and more reliable.

It would be nice if you had...

Hands-on experience with LLMs, such as prompting, LLM-as-judge or fine-tuning.

Familiarity with evaluation metrics such as precision and recall, and with using them to check automated judgements against human review.

Experience with healthcare or clinical data, or in another regulated industry, including de-identification, privacy-preserving data work or data governance for protected data (PII/PHI).

Publications in peer-reviewed venues.

Experience using coding agents in research work, with independent verification of the results.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

- Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

- Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

- Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

- Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

- Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

- Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

- Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

- Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

- Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

- Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

- Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

- Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

- Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

- Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

Title: Lead Data Scientist (Safety)
Description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Lead Data Scientist at Faculty, you will drive the scientific direction and architectural rigour of upstream AI safety and evaluation standards. Partnering directly with Frontier Labs, you will lead the design of novel experiment frameworks, mentor technical teams, and ensure delivery excellence across high-stakes engagements.

Bridging deep scientific research with client strategy, you will champion robust methodologies, guide cross-functional teams, and advance Faculty’s thought leadership in practical AI safety.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Directing project teams to deliver cutting-edge upstream AI safety solutions and evaluation standards to Frontier Labs

- Architecting core scientific experiment designs and robust software infrastructure for high-impact safety engagements

- Guiding and mentoring data scientists, nurturing technical capabilities, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing team culture

- Partnering with commercial leads and executive stakeholders to scope technical work, assess feasibility, and translate complex challenges into rigorous scientific frameworks

- Advancing Faculty’s industry leadership by innovating novel evaluation methodologies, speaking at key forums, or publishing open-source research

- Establishing and upholding scientific methodology, rigour, and engineering best practices across the full project lifecycle

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- You bring extensive leadership experience in quantitative data science, upstream AI safety research, or academic research with exemplary experiment design methodology.

- You possess advanced Python expertise alongside deep familiarity with scientific stacks (NumPy, Pandas), AI evaluation frameworks (e.g., Inspect AI), and agentic harnesses and sandboxing environments.

- You demonstrate a passion for advancing evaluation standards across complex, specialised domains, including the application of novel research avenues, with exceptional technical rigour.

- You excel at empowering others, sharing technical knowledge, and cultivating a collaborative environment where team members thrive.

- You combine strong commercial acumen with the ability to articulate complex scientific strategies clearly to senior clients and external partners.

- You drive strategic execution, scoping high-impact projects effectively to meet structured timelines without compromising quality.

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

2. Introduction to the team (30 minutes)

3. Take Home Technical Assessment

4. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

5. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

Partner with leading scientific experts to turn their judgment into datasets and automated graders, managing sensitive data under strict security controls. Communicate results, including uncertainty and negative findings, to technical staff and leadership. Google’s CBRNE team (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear and Explosives) in Responsible Frontier AI Research makes sure that as Gemini gets better at science, it does not become a tool for catastrophic harm. We are a team of engineers working alongside biologists, chemists, and physicists. (Deep expertise in one field is plenty; nobody on the team covers all of them.) This is a research engineering role: you will do applied research, write production code, and launch the resulting safeguards to billions of users. This role is probably not for you if you want to publish most of what you do, or if you are looking for a policy or purely research position. Expect strict data managing, tight release timelines, and an on-call rotation. You will read and debate technical material about mass-casualty harm and how to prevent it. You will dig into the small discrepancies that hint at big problems. One week you might design new safeguards; the next, find out why an evaluation result looked too good to be true, or attack our safeguards before someone else does. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. Title: Research Engineer, Latency & Throughput
Description:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE ROLE

As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack.

This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production.

What You Will Do

- Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses.

- Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss.

- Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack.

- Partner with pretraining and RL teams when techniques require co-training, retraining, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research.

What We're Looking For

- A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

- Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required.

- Research experience of some form: a thesis, publications, a dedicated research project, or efficiency-oriented work in a lab or industry research setting. A PhD is not required, but we are looking for genuine research depth.

- A track record of conducting experiments: forming hypotheses, designing controlled comparisons, and drawing clear conclusions from results.

- Familiarity with the state of the art in LLM inference — you know what has been tried, what works, and where the open problems are.

- Self-starter, low-ego, and collaborative. You are comfortable with ambiguity, negative results, and are eager to take matters into your own hands.

- Inference or serving experience is a plus, not a requirement. Prior work with vLLM, production LLM deployments, or serving systems will help you ramp up faster.

Location and Remote

This role is based in our Paris or London offices (hybrid). We will prioritize candidates who reside in the Paris area or are open to relocating. We strongly believe in the value of in-person collaboration to foster strong relationships and seamless communication within our team. For senior profiles, we will also consider remote candidates based in France. In that case, we ask all new hires to visit our Paris office:

Title: HPC Infrastructure Engineer - GPU Clusters
Location: United States · Bulgaria · Poland · Warsaw · United Kingdom · Remote
Description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every model we train runs on infrastructure this role owns. We operate NVIDIA GPU clusters across bare metal and rented capacity, and we're looking for an engineer to join our small research infrastructure team and make that compute fast, reliable, and boring - in the best sense. When the clusters just work, research moves faster. Your impact is measured directly in training throughput and researcher velocity.

This is a builder-operator role with real breadth: one week you're writing automation that eliminates a whole class of manual work, the next you're benchmarking a new provider's InfiniBand fabric or on-site bringing new hardware online. You'll have unusual scope and autonomy - we're a lean team where decisions are made by the people closest to the problem.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Operate and improve our GPU fleet end to end: provisioning, scheduling, monitoring, upgrades, capacity planning

- Build automation that keeps the fleet healthy without human intervention — node health checks, automated draining and remediation, burn-in pipelines for new capacity

- Own the stack beneath the training code: OS images, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, container runtimes, NCCL, high-speed networking (InfiniBand/RoCE)

- Run and tune job scheduling (Slurm or similar) so researchers get compute fairly and fast

- Build and maintain high-performance storage for datasets and checkpoints

- Hunt down performance problems: stragglers, degraded links, thermal issues, flaky GPUs — and fix the class of problem, not just the instance

- Evaluate rented GPU capacity: benchmark it, validate it, hold providers to their SLAs

- Hands-on hardware work when it's needed: racking, cabling, diagnostics, coordinating with datacenter staff and vendors

- Keep clusters secure by default: access control, network isolation, secrets

REQUIREMENTS

- Have run large-scale Linux server or GPU environments in production and enjoy both building and operating

- Know the NVIDIA stack well — drivers, CUDA, NCCL, DCGM — or have deep systems experience and learn hardware stacks fast

- Are comfortable with bare-metal environments, server hardware, and high-speed networking

- Write solid automation in Python and/or Bash, with IaC tools like Ansible or Terraform

- Are happy digging into noisy data (metrics, logs, PromQL) to find what's actually wrong

- Like owning real scope end to end and being the person others rely on

- Don't consider any task above or beneath you — datacenter trips included

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience supporting ML training workloads from the infra side (distributed training failure modes, checkpointing patterns)

- Experience evaluating and working with GPU cloud providers

- Parallel filesystems (WEKA, VAST, etc) or large-scale object storage

- BMC/IPMI/Redfish automation, PXE provisioning at scale

- Power and cooling awareness for dense GPU deployments

LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.
